title: First nonconstant monomial with nonzero coefficient
statement: Let $r$ and $\ell$ be natural numbers, and assign a coefficient in $\mathbb{F}_2$ to each monomial in $r$ variables of degree at most $\ell$. The construction returns the first, in a finite enumeration of the eligible monomials, that is nonconstant and has nonzero coefficient; it returns none if there is no such monomial.
hypotheses_covered: A coefficient in $\mathbb{F}_2$ for each monomial of degree at most $\ell$ in $r$ variables
